name: Saturn Slalom
summary:
Weave your rocket ship through a chaotic, audio-reactive galaxy in an interstellar test of skill, nerve, and speed! Perfect for quick bursts of fun or long sessions chasing that next big run.

Score points by threading your ship through the chaos of deep space, and build your combo by flying dangerously close to planets. But don’t get too close… one slip and your ship takes damage, your display cracks, and your view of the galaxy begins to glitch!

With audio-reactive visuals that pulse to the beat and effects shaped by your every move, Saturn Slalom rewards those who learn to master the flow. Your combo fuels the beat. Can you push it high enough to make the bass drop?
